Research.title: Twitch Drops for 2026 Pokémon Latin America International Championships
Research.description:
Get codes for exclusive Timed Research during the 2026 Pokémon Latin America International Championships Twitch broadcast.
Araquanid is one of the Pokémon that helped lead ItsAXN to victory at the 2025 Pokémon GO North America International Championships—and if you tune in to the 2026 LAIC stream, you’ll be able to take on the GO Battle League with your own.
Enable Twitch Drops on your Twitch account, tune in to Twitch.tv/PokemonGO during LAIC, and watch for at least 30 minutes to receive unique Timed Research in Pokémon GO that will reward you with an encounter with your own unique Araquanid.
